nodes.label: memory.mstar_exact
nodes.selector: source_identity original kernel at u=exp40 plus homogeneous memory

pointwise.physical_U_BG_formula: 0 as an input field formula; no source equality claim

exact_memory_definition.selector: source_identity original kernel at u=exp40 plus homogeneous memory

correction_density_recipe.delta_product_semantics: For a product a*b with absolute errors ea,eb, the source uses the three terms a*eb + b*ea + ea*eb in log-sum form.
correction_density_recipe.method_ownership: OriginalCompactPressureRows itself defines geometry/scalars/history_logs/error_data; correction_densities is consumed by OriginalMacroM15 and OriginalOuterM15.finite_errors.

compact_radial_specialization.physical_volume_weight: Rc^2 * x * dx, equivalently Rc^2 times the radial mass after integrating x

macro_m15.macro_mass: min(Y*q,1/2), with no extra hb factor
macro_m15.meaning_for_compact_recipe: This wrapper consumes the same correction-density rows but is distinct from the compact x-to-Rc physical measure.
macro_m15.upper_lower: upper packet at q and lower packet at native coordinate 2

outer_m15.complete_prefix: rows.error_data(Z, value, prefix=true), converted with packet_for_errors, then correction_densities against uniform_background
outer_m15.endpoint_and_viscous: logsum(upper[name]+power*upper_logR, lower[name]+power*lower_logR), power=2 for endpoint and 1 for viscous
outer_m15.prefix_error_rows: U,m,Q,U_y,Q_y rows are retained in the result; they are error enclosures

channels_and_rates.one_over_N: incoming and density source bounds already contain one over N
channels_and_rates.support_selection: m and k use support indices (0,2); h, e and p use (0,1,2)

history_and_complete_prefix.active_profile_guard: The profile-derived U and U_y rows are absent when no local/visited bump intersects {0,2}; no absent row is converted to a signed zero
history_and_complete_prefix.compact_history_source: OriginalCompactPressureRows.history_logs uses incoming_history_logs, exact C3 source frames, local/visited bumps and these history/prefix rows
history_and_complete_prefix.incoming_source: OriginalOuterPressureRows.incoming_history_logs copies previous.history_logs(Z,incoming_coordinate).history and enforces four rows; compact error_data uses previous.error_data(Z,'2') when prefix or q=1
history_and_complete_prefix.prefix_union: At a prefix or chart inlet, own U and U_y bounds are log-summed with predecessor U and U_y bounds; this is a budget union, not field equality

symbols.F_c_backward: supported_mass backward log term at rate r_c
symbols.F_c_forward: supported_mass forward log term at rate r_c
symbols.P_c_forward: supported_mass forward log term at rate 0

not_directly_bound: beta or beta_y as a separate port
the selected leading mean mstar as an exact function
a selected signed finite-N field value

pre_finish_errors.U_C3: four absolute finite-N correction log bounds U[0:4] from actual_selected_N_profile_y0_y1_y2_C3_bounds[y=0].delta_V
pre_finish_errors.U_y_C1: two absolute finite-N correction log bounds U_y[0:2] from actual_selected_N_profile_y0_y1_y2_C3_bounds[y=1].delta_V
pre_finish_errors.m_C3: four absolute finite-N correction log bounds from history or prefix_history m channel

remaining_scope: join upstream incoming anchor and physical normalization to the exact memory
bind complete-prefix correction caps to actual N-minus-BG function jets
evaluate signed Evol and independent reference offset with certified errors

retained_cap_provenance.unresolved_bridge: Bind the numeric baseline mean and complete-prefix error definitions to the native background m_C3 and the newly lifted physical Q_b; row/N/archive provenance alone is insufficient.

proof_rules: integral of zero on the source domain

full_result.static_receipt_correction: Exact baseline M ordinary Z0..3 is [4*Z*c,4*c,0,0], c=exp(-14)*mstar; the source-trace prose first entry omits Z.
